thread:
maya: Quick design review — thinking about moving the token/$ toggle out of the chart header and into a persistent top-right control so it's visible across org/project pages. Opinions?

samir: I like persistent control. feels less discoverability-by-accident if it's buried in each chart. :+1:

lisa: Agree on persistence. small nit: if it's global, we should show which scope it's affecting (org vs project) right next to it. maybe a tiny breadcrumb?

jon: Main concern: screen real estate on small widths. If we put it top-right globally, can we make it responsive (icon-only on < 900px)?

maya: Good call. icon-only is fine, but tooltip should be explicit: "View by tokens (estimated billed units) vs dollars (invoiced amounts)". aria-label needs to include scope.

billing-bot: Invoice generated: invoice-2026-02-28-ACME.pdf (internal link) — attaching for reference to line-item layout.

samir: On the charts themselves: we debated sparkline vs stacked bar for week view. Stacked bar better for token-type breakdown; sparkline better for quick trend. Could we offer a compact mode toggle in the header?

lisa: Or a hover-to-expand interaction: sparkline base, hover -> stacked breakdown overlay. Keeps compact default but surface details on demand. Also helps accessibility if keyboard-focus shows the overlay.

jon: Accessibility nit: color palette for token types must have >= 4.5 contrast on background and avoid red/green combinations. Also include a pattern overlay option for printing / colorblind.

maya: UX microcopy: change "Download invoice" CTA to "Download invoice (CSV)" when it's the CSV action and keep a separate PDF CTA. Folks keep confusing them.

samir: For org vs project default, our analytics show >70% of org admins want org-level by default. Maybe default to org for org-admins and remember per-user preference for everyone else.

lisa: Implementation detail: remember preference in user settings + quick revert in UI (tiny "reset" icon). That makes rollbacks painless for users.

jon: Dev ask: Can design provide two widths for the summary card — full width and compact (60% width) plus CSS tokens for the icon-only state? I can prototype the responsive behavior.

maya: I'll draft two mocks and add the tooltip/aria text. sharing in #design in 30m. Also will add callouts for color contrast and print patterns.

billing-bot: FYI attaching latest line-item export spec: /internal/billing/lineitems-spec-v2.pdf

lisa: One last thing — move "Export chargeback CSV" under a secondary action menu to avoid accidental clicks.

samir: Agreed. secondary menu + confirmation toast. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all — action items: I will update mocks (two widths + icon-only), add copy updates for CTA, and include accessibility callouts. tagging @design for review when done.
